title: Masala Omelette
description: Whisked eggs cooked with chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander — a quick, protein-rich breakfast ready in under 10 minutes.
steps: In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the turmeric, red chilli powder and salt.
Stir in the onion, tomato, green chilli and coriander leaves.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour in the egg mixture and let it set for a minute without stirring.
Once the base is set, gently fold the omelette over and cook for another minute until fully cooked through.
Serve hot with toast or paratha.
